name: San-J Organic Gluten-Free Tamari Soy Sauce (Wheat-Free)
whyItWorks: Authentic Japanese Tamari brewed with 100% whole soybeans and zero wheat. The extended fermentation breaks down complex proteins into simple, soothing amino acids with richer umami and zero gluten.
prepOrOrderInstructions: The gold-standard savory seasoning for IBD and celiac patients. Season white rice, chicken, or scrambled eggs.
watchOuts: Certified gluten-free and low-FODMAP in 2-tablespoon servings.
